subject: Combining backcross directions in a single analysis

messages.author: 576a22d0d43a4415
messages.subject: Combining backcross directions in a single analysis
parts:
I am in the process of designing a QTL mapping project to look at multi-trait adaptations in pine sawflies. Sawflies have haplodiploid sex determination that makes an intercross not feasible. However I am unsure about the direction of dominance in these traits, and am worried that a single backcross will not be able to detect some of the QTL. I saw that c.cross allows you to combine intercross and backcross mapping experiments. Is there a way in R/QTL to combine both directions of  backcrosses into a single analysis? 

Thanks

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Combining backcross directions in a single analysis
parts:
We don't have a way to combine reciprocal crosses.

I would suggest performing QTL analysis in the two crosses separately, and then adding LOD scores at each genomic location.

karl
